item.title: Kemopani!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: PUZZLEBOX
  • 発売日: 2008-11-21
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: けもぱにっ！
  • 英語名: Kemopani!

あらすじ

Nagare Kouyou (the protagonist) is a student attending a modern-style school. He was appointed as the vice chairman by his childhood friend and class president, Kijouin Minao, and led a school life like a servant. However, one day, he was burdened with the care of a transfer student, Masudo Mou Manami, who had animal-like ears growing on her head. Although the only visible difference was her animal ears and tail, her behavior was always unconventional and unreasonable. “I appointed her, so if she doesn’t do it properly, my evaluation will drop!” scolded by Minao, but disciplining Manami was a difficult task…

  • 英語名: Oba no Shinshitsu

あらすじ

Kenta is an ordinary uni student, that due to his parent going overseas to work he is sent to his aunt house and her daughter that lives all alone. He loves his cousin Reina who is two years older than Kenta. One day, when he smells Reina’s underwear secretly, Marina, who is Reina’s mother, turns up. She threatens him to have a sexual relationship with her… Kenta is becoming her sexual slave gradually struggling between the love toward Reina and sexual desire toward Marina.
